segments.mn88:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.mn88:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
segments.mn88:2.2: Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena pubbārāmo migāramātupāsādo tenupasaṅkami divāvihārāya.
segments.mn88:3.1: Tena kho pana samayena rājā pasenadi kosalo ekapuṇḍarīkaṃ nāgaṃ abhiruhitvā sāvatthiyā niyyāti divā divassa.
segments.mn88:3.2: Addasā kho rājā pasenadi kosalo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
segments.mn88:4.1: Atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi –
segments.mn88:4.2: “ehi tvaṃ, ambho purisa, yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena āyasmato ānandassa pāde sirasā vandāhi –
segments.mn88:4.3: ‘rājā, bhante, pasenadi kosalo āyasmato ānandassa pāde sirasā vandatī’ti.
segments.mn88:4.5: ‘sace kira, bhante, āyasmato ānandassa na kiñci accāyikaṃ karaṇīyaṃ, āgametu kira, bhante, āyasmā ānando muhuttaṃ anukampaṃ upādāyā’”ti.
segments.mn88:5.1: “Evaṃ, devā”ti kho so puriso rañño pasenadissa kosalassa paṭissutvā yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn88:5.2: “rājā, bhante, pasenadi kosalo āyasmato ānandassa pāde sirasā vandati;
segments.mn88:5.4: ‘sace kira, bhante, āyasmato ānandassa na kiñci accāyikaṃ karaṇīyaṃ, āgametu kira, bhante, āyasmā ānando muhuttaṃ anukampaṃ upādāyā’”ti.
segments.mn88:6.2: Atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo yāvatikā nāgassa bhūmi nāgena gantvā nāgā paccorohitvā pattikova yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho rājā pasenadi kosalo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn88:6.3: “sace, bhante, āyasmato ānandassa na kiñci accāyikaṃ karaṇīyaṃ, sādhu, bhante, āyasmā ānando yena aciravatiyā nadiyā tīraṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
segments.mn88:7.2: Atha kho āyasmā ānando yena aciravatiyā nadiyā tīraṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle paññatte āsane nisīdi.
segments.mn88:7.3: Atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo yāvatikā nāgassa bhūmi nāgena gantvā nāgā paccorohitvā pattikova yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho rājā pasenadi kosalo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn88:8.1: Nisīdi kho rājā pasenadi kosalo paññatte āsane.
segments.mn88:8.2: Nisajja kho rājā pasenadi kosalo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn88:8.3: “kiṃ nu kho, bhante ānanda, so bhagavā tathārūpaṃ kāyasamācāraṃ samācareyya, yvāssa kāyasamācāro opārambho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehī”ti [brāhmaṇehi viññūhīti (sabbattha) aṭṭhakathā ṭīkā oloketabbā]?
segments.mn88:8.4: “Na kho, mahārāja, so bhagavā tathārūpaṃ kāyasamācāraṃ samācareyya, yvāssa kāyasamācāro opārambho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhī”ti.
segments.mn88:8.5: “Kiṃ pana, bhante ānanda, so bhagavā tathārūpaṃ vacīsamācāraṃ … pe …
segments.mn88:8.6: manosamācāraṃ samācareyya, yvāssa manosamācāro opārambho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehī”ti [brāhmaṇehi viññūhīti (sabbattha) aṭṭhakathā ṭīkā oloketabbā]?
segments.mn88:8.7: “Na kho, mahārāja, so bhagavā tathārūpaṃ manosamācāraṃ samācareyya, yvāssa manosamācāro opārambho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhī”ti.
segments.mn88:9.2: Yañhi mayaṃ, bhante, nāsakkhimhā pañhena paripūretuṃ taṃ, bhante, āyasmatā ānandena pañhassa veyyākaraṇena paripūritaṃ.
segments.mn88:9.3: Ye te, bhante, bālā abyattā ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā paresaṃ vaṇṇaṃ vā avaṇṇaṃ vā bhāsanti, na mayaṃ taṃ sārato paccāgacchāma;
segments.mn88:9.4: ye pana [ye ca kho (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] te, bhante, paṇḍitā viyattā [byattā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] medhāvino anuvicca pariyogāhetvā paresaṃ vaṇṇaṃ vā avaṇṇaṃ vā bhāsanti, mayaṃ taṃ sārato paccāgacchāma”.
segments.mn88:10.1: “Katamo pana, bhante ānanda, kāyasamācāro opārambho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhī”ti?
segments.mn88:10.6: “Yo kho, mahārāja, kāyasamācāro sabyābajjho”[sabyāpajjho (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.), sabyāpajjo (ka.)].
segments.mn88:10.10: “Yo kho, mahārāja, kāyasamācāro attabyābādhāyapi saṃvattati, parabyābādhāyapi saṃvattati, ubhayabyābādhāyapi saṃvattati
segments.mn88:10.11: tassa akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti;
segments.mn88:10.12: evarūpo kho, mahārāja, kāyasamācāro opārambho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhī”ti.
segments.mn88:12.4: “Yo kho, mahārāja, manosamācāro attabyābādhāyapi saṃvattati, parabyābādhāyapi saṃvattati, ubhayabyābādhāyapi saṃvattati
segments.mn88:12.5: tassa akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti;
segments.mn88:12.6: evarūpo kho, mahārāja, manosamācāro opārambho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhī”ti.
segments.mn88:13.1: “Kiṃ nu kho, bhante ānanda, so bhagavā sabbesaṃyeva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ vaṇṇetī”ti?
segments.mn88:14.1: “Katamo pana, bhante ānanda, kāyasamācāro anopārambho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhī”ti?
segments.mn88:14.10: “Yo kho, mahārāja, kāyasamācāro nevattabyābādhāyapi saṃvattati, na parabyābādhāyapi saṃvattati, na ubhayabyābādhāyapi saṃvattati
segments.mn88:14.11: tassa akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti;
segments.mn88:14.12: evarūpo kho, mahārāja, kāyasamācāro anopārambho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhī”ti.
segments.mn88:16.6: “Yo kho, mahārāja, manosamācāro nevattabyābādhāyapi saṃvattati, na parabyābādhāyapi saṃvattati, na ubhayabyābādhāyapi saṃvattati.
segments.mn88:16.7: Tassa akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti.
segments.mn88:16.8: Evarūpo kho, mahārāja, manosamācāro anopārambho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhī”ti.
segments.mn88:17.1: “Kiṃ pana, bhante ānanda, so bhagavā sabbesaṃyeva kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadaṃ vaṇṇetī”ti?
segments.mn88:18.2: Yāva subhāsitaṃ cidaṃ [subhāsitamidaṃ (sī.)], bhante, āyasmatā ānandena.
segments.mn88:18.3: Iminā ca mayaṃ, bhante, āyasmato ānandassa subhāsitena attamanābhiraddhā.
segments.mn88:18.4: Evaṃ attamanābhiraddhā ca mayaṃ, bhante, āyasmato ānandassa subhāsitena.
segments.mn88:18.5: Sace, bhante, āyasmato ānandassa hatthiratanaṃ kappeyya, hatthiratanampi mayaṃ āyasmato ānandassa dadeyyāma.
segments.mn88:18.6: Sace, bhante, āyasmato ānandassa assaratanaṃ kappeyya, assaratanampi mayaṃ āyasmato ānandassa dadeyyāma.
segments.mn88:18.7: Sace, bhante, āyasmato ānandassa gāmavaraṃ kappeyya, gāmavarampi mayaṃ āyasmato ānandassa dadeyyāma.
segments.mn88:18.8: Api ca, bhante, mayampetaṃ [mayameva taṃ (sī.), mayampanetaṃ (syā. kaṃ.)] jānāma –
segments.mn88:18.10: Ayaṃ me, bhante, bāhitikā raññā māgadhena ajātasattunā vedehiputtena vatthanāḷiyā [chattanāḷiyā (syā. kaṃ. pī.)] pakkhipitvā pahitā soḷasasamā āyāmena, aṭṭhasamā vitthārena.
segments.mn88:18.11: Taṃ, bhante, āyasmā ānando paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
segments.mn88:19.1: “Ayaṃ, bhante, aciravatī nadī diṭṭhā āyasmatā ceva ānandena amhehi ca.
segments.mn88:19.2: Yadā uparipabbate mahāmegho abhippavuṭṭho hoti, athāyaṃ aciravatī nadī ubhato kūlāni saṃvissandantī gacchati;
segments.mn88:19.3: evameva kho, bhante, āyasmā ānando imāya bāhitikāya attano ticīvaraṃ karissati.
segments.mn88:19.4: Yaṃ panāyasmato ānandassa purāṇaṃ ticīvaraṃ taṃ sabrahmacārīhi saṃvibhajissati.
segments.mn88:19.5: Evāyaṃ amhākaṃ dakkhiṇā saṃvissandantī maññe gamissati.
segments.mn88:20.2: Atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn88:20.3: “handa ca dāni mayaṃ, bhante ānanda, gacchāma;
segments.mn88:20.6: Atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo āyasmato ānandassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
segments.mn88:21.1: Atha kho āyasmā ānando acirapakkantassa rañño pasenadissa kosalassa yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.mn88:21.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando yāvatako ahosi raññā pasenadinā kosalena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
segments.mn88:22.2: “lābhā, bhikkhave, rañño pasenadissa kosalassa, suladdhalābhā, bhikkhave, rañño pasenadissa kosalassa;
segments.mn88:22.3: yaṃ rājā pasenadi kosalo labhati ānandaṃ dassanāya, labhati payirupāsanāyā”ti.
segments.mn88:22.5: Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.

lines: Tassa kira phāsukānaṃ upari tālaphalamattaṃ paṇḍaraṭṭhānaṃ atthi, tenassa ekapuṇḍarīkoti nāmaṃ akaṃsu.
Sirivaḍḍhaṃ mahāmattanti paccekahatthiṃ abhiruhitvā kathāphāsukatthaṃ saddhiṃ gacchantaṃ evaṃnāmakaṃ mahāmattaṃ.
Mahāmatto therassa saṅghāṭipattadhāraṇākāraṃ sallakkhetvā “evaṃ, mahārājā”ti āha.
Sundarivatthusmiṃ uppannamidaṃ suttaṃ, taṃ pucchāmīti pucchati.
Yañhi mayaṃ, bhanteti, bhante, yaṃ mayaṃ viññūhīti idaṃ padaṃ gahetvā pañhena paripūretuṃ nāsakkhimhā, taṃ kāraṇaṃ āyasmatā evaṃ vadantena paripūritaṃ.
Sabbākusaladhammapahīno kho, mahārāja, tathāgato kusaladhammasamannāgatoti ettha sabbesaṃyeva akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ vaṇṇetīti.
Āma vaṇṇetīti vutte yathā pucchā, tathā attho vutto bhaveyya.
Appahīnaakusalopi hi pahānaṃ vaṇṇeyya, bhagavā pana pahīnākusalatāya yathākārī tathāvādīti dassetuṃ evaṃ byākāsi.
Datvā ca pana gandhakuṭiyaṃ vitānaṃ katvā bandhi.
Neyyapuggalassa pana vasena ayaṃ desanā niṭṭhitāti.
Bālā upārambhavatthumaññaṃ amūlakampi naṃ āropentā ugghosenti, tasmā te anāmasitvā “viññūhī”ti idaṃ padaṃ gahetvā pañhena ñātuṃ icchitena atthena upārambhādīnaṃ upari uttaraṃ paripūretuṃ nāsakkhimhā.
Yadi hi mayā “viññūhī”ti padaṃ pakkhipitvā vuttaṃ bhaveyya, pañhā me paripuṇṇā bhaveyya, na pana vuttā.
Idāni pana taṃ kāraṇaṃ uttaraṃ āyasmatā ānandena “viññūhī”ti evaṃ vadantena paripūritaṃ.
Avajjaṃ vuccati garahitabbaṃ, saha avajjehīti sāvajjo, gārayho.
Tehi eva sabyābajjho, tato eva sampati āyatiñca sadukkho.
Tathā attho vutto bhaveyyāti pucchāsabhāgenapi attho vutto bhaveyya, pucchantassa pana na tāva cittārādhanaṃ.
“evaṃ byākaraṇaṃ pana na bhāriyan”ti, garukaraṇaṃ na hoti visārajjaṃ na siyāti adhippāyo.
Evarūpo pana yathākārī tathāvādī na hoti, na evaṃ bhagavāti āha “bhagavā”tiādi.
Evaṃ byākāsīti “sabbākusaladhammapahīno kho, mahārāja, tathāgato”ti evaṃ byākāsi.

Sukkapakkhepi eseva nayoti iminā “sabbesaṃyeva kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadaṃ vaṇṇetī”ti vutte yathā pucchā, tathā attho vutto bhaveyya, evaṃ byākaraṇaṃ pana na bhāriyaṃ, asampāditakusaladhammopi upasampadaṃ vaṇṇeyya.
Bhagavā pana sammadeva sampāditakusalattā yathākārī tathāvādīti dassetuṃ “evaṃ byākāsī”ti imamatthaṃ dasseti.
